## 2026-11-11 · mabinogi-002 · the 6-shaped w standing for /v/
Col. 14 l. 26 Evans prints "ny wydwn i 6arch" (the witness: "varch"). The establish rule (6-shaped w → w) gives "warch"; the
published pilot printed v in like places ("Vrth ual", "Y vely", "a'y vreic"). Decided meanwhile: follow the rule ("warch"),
the drafter's note to say it is *march* soft-mutated, spelt with the w-letter. The owner may prefer v where the sound is /v/.

## 2026-11-11 · mabinogi-003 · small open points
- "a'y dodi yn y carchar e hun" (col. 24): whose prison is not said, and *carchar* is unmutated after 'his' (Red Book *y garchar*). Decided meanwhile: `l`/`i` "his own", note says the referent is uncertain.
- "nit eidawaf y rodi y neb" (col. 22): rare; Red Book "nyt adawaf". Decided meanwhile: text as the White Book, read 'it is not mine to give', flagged uncertain.
- Published glossary entries *gelwit*, *gyweirwyt* say "3 sg. impersonal"; the 003 review uses "impersonal". Left unchanged (outside this part); the owner may want them aligned.

## 2026-11-11 · mabinogi-004 · small open points
- Col. 34 l. 21: "nat oed iawn udunt wy attal y mab ganthaw" — Evans prints singular *ganthaw* where the witness has *ganthunt*. Decided meanwhile: text as the White Book; the note will say so.
- Col. 37 l. 18: "Teirnon Toryfliant" against "Twryf Uliant" elsewhere in the part. Decided meanwhile: printed as written; English "Teirnon Twrf Liant" throughout, the note says the spelling differs.

## 2026-11-12 · mabinogi-004 · word division at col. 30
- "am gyflauan mor anwedus ac ar y wnaethoed" (unit 40): Evans prints *arýwnaethoed* as one run, so the division "ar y" is ours (from the witness). The sense wants *a ry wnaethoed* 'that she had done' (relative a + perfective ry; Red Book *ac a wnathoed*). Decided meanwhile: text left as established ("ar y"); the note explains it as *a ry*, and the glossary entries stand with either division. The owner may want the text re-divided "ac a ry wnaethoed" (a re-pin of the established text).
